content.text: {"Id":"BUG-TRIAGE-131","Title":"beginTurn hard-fails when SessionLog.SubmitAsync times out after 30s","Section":"Backlog","Priority":"high","Done":false,"Estimate":null,"Note":null,"Description":["After a successful trusted Codex plugin session-start, UserPromptSubmit builds a turn requestId and calls workflow.sessionlog.beginTurn. That path writes local current-turn state, queues a session_submit failsafe, then requires client.SessionLog.SubmitAsync to succeed. Get-ReplMethodTimeoutSeconds defaults non-long methods (including sessionlog) to 30s; Invoke-ReplRaw kills mcpserver-repl on that budget and returns failure. Invoke-ReplPersistTurn throws on that failure even though the failsafe YAML was already written, beginTurn returns false, and plugin-hook emits turn-open-failed. Expected behavior is either durable open within budget or a recoverable degraded/queued open using the existing failsafe drain path rather than a hard turn-open failure after trusted bootstrap.","Triage group: triage-group-86f4aa0fa34db3ff","Reports: 1"],"TechnicalDetails":["Acceptance criteria:","- Given trusted session-start succeeded and session-state.yaml has a sessionId, when UserPromptSubmit invokes workflow.sessionlog.beginTurn and client.SessionLog.SubmitAsync does not complete within the default 30s REPL timeout, the plugin must not leave the agent without a usable turn contract: either the turn is durably opened on the server, or the hook returns a recoverable degraded/queued state with failsafe retained and current-turn.yaml active for the requestId.","- When SubmitAsync times out after failsafe write, the hook must not report only turn-open-failed with no recovery path; failsafe session_submit payload must remain queued for later drain/replay and must not be discarded.","- When SubmitAsync completes within timeout, beginTurn still opens the turn, creates matching current-turn.yaml for the requestId, clears the failsafe, and returns turn-opened as today.","- A regression test covers the timeout path for workflow.sessionlog.beginTurn / client.SessionLog.SubmitAsync and asserts either durable success or explicit recoverable queued/degraded open rather than silent hard failure after successful bootstrap.","Implementation notes:","- Primary code: plugins/core/lib-ps/repl-invoke.ps1 (Get-ReplMethodTimeoutSeconds default 30s; Invoke-ReplRaw Wait timeout; Invoke-ReplPersistTurn failsafe-then-SubmitAsync; Invoke-WorkflowBeginTurn requires persisted=true), plugins/core/lib-ps/plugin-hook.ps1 UserPromptSubmit (status turn-open-failed on beginTurn failure).","- Failsafe infrastructure already treats \u0027timed out\u0027 as backend-unreachable (Test-ReplFailsafeBackendUnreachable) and supports drain/replay (TR-MCP-REPL-016/017). Gap is beginTurn treating timeout as terminal after failsafe write instead of degraded open \u002B queued replay.","- Consider whether 30s is too aggressive for SubmitAsync under load, whether beginTurn should accept local turn open \u002B failsafe when transport times out, and/or raise sessionlog submit timeout without reintroducing BUG-TRIAGE-072 hang risk.","- Server-side SessionLogClient.SubmitAsync / SessionLogController.SubmitAsync may also be slow; investigate only if client timeout persists after plugin degraded-open handling, without broad repo search.","- Do not use raw REST bypass; fix remains on plugin workflow.sessionlog / client.SessionLog.SubmitAsync path used by mcpserver-codex-plugin."],"ImplementationTasks":null,"CompletedDate":null,"DoneSummary":null,"Remaining":null,"PriorityNote":null,"Reference":null,"Phase":null,"DependsOn":null,"FunctionalRequirements":["FR-MCP-TRIAGE-002"],"TechnicalRequirements":["TR-MCP-TRIAGE-004"],"IdempotencyKey":null}
